documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-09-22-15-ad-14-2026-1: On 22 September 2026, under ref. 15 Ad 14/2026-12, the Prague Municipal Court stated that the court fee paid in proceeding 8 Ad 9/2026 cannot be transferred to the separate fee obligation in proceeding 15 Ad 14/2026. The Court also stated that an instruction to refund the fee paid in 8 Ad 9/2026 had already been issued. The communication does not terminate proceeding 15 Ad 14/2026 and sets no new deadline.
